messages:
Jess (docs): quick FYI 1:30 scan found ~24 links to /runbooks/ops/* that are 404 after the recent slug rename. sample broken: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/ops/cache-warmup -> 404. Who's the owner for runbooks/ops? We should triage before Friday. :calendar:

DocScanBot: link-scan results uploaded: https://internal/reports/link-scan/9201111111. Counts: 24 broken links across 5 files (mostly internal cross-links + a couple from onboarding).

Omar G: I used to own several runbooks but re-assigned a while back. I can take cache-warmup + traffic-surge.

Priya S: I can do a sed pass in the content repo to update references to new slugs. Proposed mapping: /runbooks/ops/ -> /runbooks/run-ops/ (migration doc states new prefix). Command I'll use locally: ```git clone git@github.com:redwood/docs.git && rg "runbooks/ops/" --files | xargs -n1 sed -i "s:/runbooks/ops/:/runbooks/run-ops/:g"``` Will open small PRs per directory. Is the /runbooks/run-ops/ prefix final?

Ben K: yes, /runbooks/run-ops/ is the canonical new prefix. Migration notes: https://internal/migrations/runbooks-2026. We intentionally left some aliases out to avoid collisions.

Jess (docs): ok plan: 1) Owners (Omar, Priya) split list; 2) Priya will run mass-fix PRs; 3) if urgent external links exist, Leila can re-add shortlink aliases temporarily. i'll create an issue to track: https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/420 (will paste the CSV of slugs).

Leila: I can re-add shortlinks for partner-facing URIs if we find any external traffic. Shortlinks service is configured; note: changes require a small TTL (~10m) to propagate. I prefer inbound fixes for long-term.

Omar G: opened PR for cache-warmup + traffic-surge: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012 1:46 (updates internal links and adds redirect meta). Jess, please review when you have a sec.

OpsOncallBot: reminder 1:50 there are two runbook pages referenced from the oncall playbook that will impact runbook lookups. Tagging @Ops.

Priya S: starting ripgrep/sed run now. I'll split into 4 PRs (~6 files each) and tag Docs + Eng reviewers. First PR expected in ~30m. Will include a changelog entry: "fix: update runbook slugs after migration"

Ben K: if PRs touch frontmatter canonical fields, double-check canonical vs shortlink precedence. We had one regression last month where canonical pointed to old slug.

Jess (docs): good catch. PR checklist: (a) update link, (b) update canonical if present, (c) add changelog line, (d) add codeowner review. I'll monitor the PRs and queue reviewers.

Leila: once PRs merge, i'll run a quick smoke scan and then prune any temporary alias additions. If partners still hit old URLs, we can add a per-URL redirect in shortlinks and track it in the issue.

Priya S: PR #5013 opened (batch 1): https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5013. Staging preview: https://staging.kb.redwood.ai/pull/5013. Tests: build + linkcheck running.

Jess (docs): reviewing PR #5013 now. small nit: please squash fixup commits and ensure each commit message describes scope.

Priya S: noted, will tidy commit history before merge.

Omar G: if anyone finds a runbook page I missed, drop it in the issue or DM me. I'll pick up leftovers after Priya's batch lands.

Jess (docs): thanks all. i'll update docs-owner registry to list Omar + Priya as maintainers for runbooks/run-ops. will close tracking issue once staging linkcheck is green for all PRs. :rocket:
